gloss: the "hand" radical (扌); left-side hand radical in kanji

definitions.gloss: the kanji radical {扌|てへん} ("hand"), as it appears on the left side of a character
definitions.explanation: The {扌|てへん} radical is a stylized form of {手|て} ("hand") used as the left-side ({偏|へん}) component of many kanji. Most kanji that contain てへん relate in some way to actions of the hand — pushing, pulling, holding, hitting, etc. Examples include {打|う}つ ("to hit"), {持|も}つ ("to hold"), {押|お}す ("to push"), and {投|な}げる ("to throw").

examples.english: Kanji with the hand radical are related to the hand.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧」はてへん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{投|とう}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write "{投|な}げる," you write the hand radical on the left and the right side of "{投|とう}."

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「てへん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|ほそ}く→細い：02962_hosoi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧だ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher explained, "The hand radical (てへん) is a slimmed-down form of the character for 'hand'."

notes:
てへん is the name of the kanji radical {扌|てへん}, which is a stylized form of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ ("hand") used as the left-side component of many kanji. It is one of the most productive radicals in Japanese: most kanji built with てへん denote actions performed with the hands.

FORMS:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ ("hand") + ~へん (⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧, "left-side radical")
- The ん in てへん comes from the rendaku-flavored reading of ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧.

COMMON KANJI WITH てへん:
- ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧: to hit
- ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold
- ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to push
- ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to pull (note: this kanji uses ゆみへん ⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧ instead, so a useful contrast)
- ⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧: to throw
- ⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to wave / shake
- ⟦{折|お}る→折る：01263_oru⟧: to fold / break
- ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away

RELATED RADICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{偏|へん}→偏：26560_hen⟧: left-side radical (the position-name suffix used in てへん, ⟦さんずい→さんずい：09495_sanzui⟧, ⟦きへん→きへん：23625_kihen⟧, etc.)
- ⟦さんずい→さんずい：09495_sanzui⟧: "three drops of water" radical ({氵|さんずい}), found in water-related kanji
- ⟦きへん→きへん：23625_kihen⟧: "tree" radical (⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧), found in wood/tree-related kanji
- ⟦くさかんむり→くさかんむり：27337_kusakanmuri⟧: "grass crown" radical ({艹|くさかんむり}), found above the character
- ⟦{部首|ぶしゅ}→部首：00023_bushu⟧: kanji radical (the general term)

USAGE:
- てへん is often introduced very early in elementary-school kanji education as a memorable example of how radicals carry meaning. Teachers commonly say things like "てへん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧" ("It has the hand radical, so it has something to do with the hand").
- The radical {扌|てへん} is never written as a standalone character; it appears only as the left-side element of other kanji.
